mentions.name: ExamineIP
mentions.description: Free network security toolkit offering 15 client-side diagnostic tools, including a VPN leak test, DNS checker, and port scanner. Built after a WiFi security incident, it runs entirely client-side with no data collection.
mentions.problem: Created in response to a WiFi security incident, addressing the need for accessible network security diagnostics.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am building ExamineIP - Free network security toolkit

https://tools.examineip.com

Collection of 15 diagnostic tools (VPN leak test, DNS checker, port scanner, 
etc.) built after a WiFi security incident. All client-side, no data collection.
